game.help:
Press + to buzz in, || to pause or resume, and ! immediately after a question to appeal. Pausing is available between questions when enabled.
Reply to the bot's prompt; /answer reopens it. To appeal, choose an answer number if a list is offered. Vote using the buttons below the appeal message; vote totals update automatically. Escalate with /escalate yes or /escalate no; supply details with /commentary.
/score, /themes, /players, /results show game information. /abandon asks for confirmation using buttons. /reconnect returns to a running game if you have not entered a new one. After completion: /report and /quit.
